title: Very poor stability in 4.6, and bad stability in 4.5 , regarding most docked tabs.
body:
### Tested versions

happens on : v4.6.beta1.mono.official [d743736f8]

and 4.5 stable

and any 4.6 dev version inbetween



### System information

Godot v4.6.beta1.mono - Pop!_OS 24.04 LTS on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-12650H (16 threads) - 15.34 GiB memory

### Issue description

After 4.4 ( not inclusive ) godots stability has been not good at all for me, basically any tab in the bottom dock will cause a crash if you look at it the wrong way

Animation tab is a guaranteed crash:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0fa5545c-edfc-4f07-a154-c1130e968c8b

Debugger tab will crash most of the time and pretty much always on launching game:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b89d45ca-fa23-465e-ab15-1fdac9748850

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6ebd13bd-72b8-4542-912a-dfa2dd117b6b

meanwhile 4,4,1 continues to run amazingly, so i very much doubt its my pc 

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/83302909-da24-49d4-bd0d-a85807391977

Its basically unusable unless you dont debug, dont use godots animation, dont even acidentally click on either ever

i believe ive had crashes swtiching to the shader tab too but havent been able to repro; 



### Steps to reproduce

Literally do anything in the bottom tabs for 2 minutes

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Not applicable
